note: Generated from the tables of STD-WFB-01; where the two differ, the document is right and this file is regenerated

areas.DSP: Display philosophy: levels, colour, layout, values and text, motion, commands, faceplates
areas.TAG: Tag hierarchy and naming above the device folder
areas.UDT: The choice and use of user defined types

rules.statement: Every page of the target is given one display level of ISA-101: level 1 the site overview and each overview that spans the site for one discipline; level 2 area and unit pages; level 3 faceplates; level 4 diagnostics, information, alarm lists and help pages

overview_markers.allowed: Words matched in any case in an original page's menu label or title

rules.statement: Where the plant has areas, every process page names its node, and under an ASM frame its level word, by the keys of wiki page 16 section 3.2 rules 3 and 4
A project whose plant has areas is built with an ASM frame, chosen between asm and obasm by the rendering as wiki page 16 section 3.2 rules 1 and 2 state; that frame's top bar carries principle P11
A normal state is shown in the library's neutral palette; no normal state is shown in an alert colour, red or green; the media colours of pipes (HMI-DSP-06) are the one exception
Every state the operator acts on is coded by shape, line or text as well as colour
rules.check_note: judged at the design review; the library codes alarm priorities by colour with one badge shape (wiki page 04 section 7 item 3, WFB-339)

rules.statement: A descriptor sets no colour, class or style beyond the keys the library's schema offers for it (for example an indicator's states, wiki page 16 section 6.1 Table 8)
Pipes are coloured as the parameter pipe_colour states, by the media of wiki page 16 section 10.1 Table 13
A page keeps the original's topology and the order of its regions; a region moves only as a whole, into an empty band, and is never split; a flow keeps its sequence
Each page renders on the page canvas of the library's frame at the profile's window as the parameter fit states
Repeated panels share one size and stand in one row or one column; a row of like devices spreads across the width
A symbol on a flow is centred on its line and turned along it; text never lies over other text, a symbol or a line
Every label names the item it stood beside in the original and keeps its order among its neighbours
An original page that shows a process path is drawn in the diagram layout of wiki page 16 section 5, never as cards
rules.check_note: a design choice, shown at the design review

rules.statement: A value that has states is shown in words, never as a bare number
An analogue value carries the unit symbol of its tag; where the facts give a range, it carries a range bar with its normal band and limits, by the means wiki page 16 section 9 offers

No measurement is invented in the delivered target: a value the original shows from a tag is bound to that tag, and a value with no source is a gap accepted by name, never a constant or a simulated value drawn as live
Motion (flashing, blinking, animation) is used only for unacknowledged alarms
Pipes are animated only where the parameter pipe_animation is true
Every state-changing command and every setpoint write asks the operator to confirm before it is written; of the acknowledgements, only Ack all asks (HMI-ALM-06)
sources: ASMP report section 5.3 item 1 (a source with no confirmation)

rules.statement: An original page button that commands a device becomes a command of that device's faceplate, where wiki page 16 section 10.2 places a device's command
Where the original has modes, the device carries ownership by mode as wiki page 16 section 11 Table 15 offers
rules.check_note: decided by the device model's `modes`, shown at the design review

rules.statement: Where the parameter popups_as_faceplates is true, a pop-up of the original that serves a device becomes that device's faceplate, never a page; a pop-up that serves no device becomes a level 4 page or a gap accepted by name
Faceplates are the library's, in the style wiki page 16 section 4.1 names for an ASM operation and in the place section 4.2 states
Each device's own drawing (wiki page 16 section 8 Table 11) stands on a page of the device's ratified node (HMI-TAG-01); every other page that shows the device draws a second drawing
A plain symbol of the original that stood for a device opens that device's faceplate as the parameter faceplates_on_plain_symbols states
rules.check_note: a design choice, shown at the design review

rules.statement: Under an ASM frame (HMI-DSP-25), the operator navigates by the plant hierarchy: the tree with search, the breadcrumb with alarm counts per priority, and the pivot pages of a node
Every navigation target of the original, including an opener whose target the navigation table lists as unresolved, is routed to a page or a faceplate of the target, or is a gap accepted by name
A symbol opens its faceplate and a separate link navigates; the same click never does both
Every route that a design names is generated; a page names no route that the target does not hold
sources: WFB-293 (the trends route the design named and the build did not generate)

rules.statement: Every item of the original with a place on the page is drawn visibly at that place, or is a gap the person accepts by name
A stand-in for a kind the library lacks shows the original's shape at its place and size, from the captured geometry, in a neutral style
A claim of the design about what the library holds or lacks agrees with the library's catalogue as the run holds it
Every gap accepted by name is listed, with its identifier, reason and the person who accepted it, on the design sheet and on the final review
An item drawn from the original's geometry shows no live state unless it is bound to a tag the census holds

Every alarm condition of the original's alarm tables becomes one alarm of the target in the library's form, on the member or source tag where wiki page 17 sections 7.3 and 7.4 place it, or is a gap accepted by name
The original's alarm priorities map onto the five priorities of wiki page 17 Table 21 by the parameter priorities_by_rank; a rank the map does not name is a gap, never a guess

priorities_by_rank.allowed: Keys: the original's priority ranks as decimal strings; values: critical, high, medium, low, diagnostic

rules.statement: A priority the design infers where the original states none is recorded in the design's alarm entry with priority_source inferred, and shown at the design review, as the parameter inferred_alarm_priorities states
sources: ASMP report section 5.4 (22 alarms with no priority)

rules.statement: An alarm of the original that needs no operator action is carried with the Diagnostic priority of wiki page 17 section 7.2, through the map of HMI-ALM-02

The target shows the ISA-18.2 states normal, unacknowledged active, acknowledged active and returned to normal unacknowledged; suppressed by design and out of service are offered only once the library has proved them on a gateway
Where the parameter acknowledge is selected_and_all_after_confirm, every alarm list offers Ack selected and Ack all, Ack all after a confirmation, as wiki page 04 section 8.12 states

Alarms are shelved only through the library's alarm tables, with their shelving times (wiki page 17 section 7.2 Table 21, wiki page 13 section 11.4); no script, tag write or page control of the target shelves an alarm
The migration report lists every carried alarm, per priority, as not rationalised, for the site's rationalisation; the migration changes no alarm's priority, limit or text to rationalise it
An alarm's text is the original's alarm description, placed in the label form of wiki page 13 section 11.3 item 1
An alarm's display path names the same node as the device's tag path (HMI-TAG-01), so that the counts, the breadcrumb and the tag browser agree
An on-delay the original states for a limit of a tank, an instrument or a controller is carried to that limit's delay member (wiki page 17 section 5.2)
Where the census gives a device an acknowledgement member of the original, the device carries the acknowledgement relay of wiki page 17 section 5.3 bound to it
The migration report states the distribution of the carried alarms over Low, Medium and High against the parameter priority_distribution, with the Critical alarms counted apart

priority_distribution.allowed: Keys low, medium, high; values: numbers from 0 to 1 that sum to 1

rules.statement: A deadband, or an on-delay of an alarm whose kind has no delay member, is listed on the migration report with its value, since the library holds neither
sources: L17 section 11 item 2 (the timeOnDelaySeconds binding unmeasured)

rules.statement: Device folders are grouped by the plant hierarchy under the child project's tag root, at <tagRoot>/<node path>/<device>, the node path being the device's ratified node, area then unit (NOTE-WFB-16 section 11); a device that no source places sits in the area unplaced_area until the person places it, and the final review lists it; where the person ratifies no area for the plant, the folders sit directly under the tag root and the pages name no node
sources: ISA101 (the display hierarchy follows the plant)

unplaced_area.allowed: An area name of HMI-TAG-02's characters

rules.statement: The device folder keeps the original's equipment id, made safe: each character outside the ASCII letters, digits, underscore and hyphen becomes an underscore; two names that become equal without regard to case within one parent folder are refused at the design check and renamed by the person on the ratification card
sources: GF-11 (no slash in a tag name)

rules.statement: An area or unit folder takes the name of the original's area or unit as the person ratified it, made safe as HMI-TAG-02 states

A tag that belongs to no device (a free readout of a page) sits in the folder values_folder of the node of the pages that show it; where they are pages of several nodes, of their deepest common node, or of the tag root where they share none
sources: WFB NOTE-WFB-14 section 4.6 (free tags placed under no rule)

values_folder.allowed: A folder name of HMI-TAG-02's characters

rules.statement: A memory tag that stands in for a missing source (a design gap) sits in the folder unsourced_folder of its node; it is listed on the final review, is never counted as bound by CK-DSP-15, and a value read from it is drawn as a gap, never as live

unsourced_folder.allowed: A folder name of HMI-TAG-02's characters

rules.statement: A device member's source is a tag of the original or a memory tag of HMI-TAG-05; a member with neither is not created, as wiki page 17 section 2.2 item 2 requires
The child project's tags sit under the profile's target.tag_root, whose bracketed prefix names the tag provider
The node path has at most max_levels levels; a deeper plant model of the original is ratified to that depth on the card (NOTE-WFB-16), so that the node path and the folder path stay one string
sources: ASMP report section 5.7 item 2 (a four-level model)

rules.statement: Where adopt_udts is true, every device of a library kind with a UDT on wiki page 17 (section 3.2 Table 2) is an instance of the library's definition for its kind, placed and named as NOTE-WFB-15 section 9.3 states, whenever every shape the instance needs is marked measured in the library's manifest (HMI-UDT-05); otherwise the device is a folder of atomic tags and CK-UDT-01 reports not_applicable with the unmeasured shape named

A variant definition that wiki page 17 section 3.2 rules 1 to 3 call for is derived from the device model's member sets and named by the library's tool, as NOTE-WFB-15 section 9.3 states; the person may give a variant a readable name on the design review card
The target's types are the library's; the original's own types (Citect genie and equipment types) and the UDT families of another project are never copied as types of the target
sources: ASMP report section 5.1 item 5 (no source member maps exactly to the library's)

rules.statement: No type is made for a kind to which the library gives none (the local device, wiki page 17 section 3.2 Table 2)
No UDT shape that wiki page 17 section 11 item 2 marks unmeasured reaches a site's gateway before it is measured on the cloud gateway and marked measured in the library's manifest
A write under the provider's _types_ folder on the owner's gateway is made only with the owner's authorisation
rules.check_note: COBD-035 governs; the write waits for the owner's authorisation

rules.statement: History is configured on the members wiki page 17 section 8 Table 22 marks for each kind; on a UDT instance only once the history keys on a type member are measured (HMI-UDT-05)

Every tag the original trends (its trend tag records as ctig extracts them) is historised in the target and shown on the trend page, a node's trend pivot or an embedded trend, or is a gap accepted by name
History is written to the provider the parameter history_provider names

history_provider.allowed: The name of a history provider of the gateway

rules.statement: The migration report lists each historised member with the sample period of the original's trend tag, since wiki page 17 section 8 gives the target no sample key
A device model's trend list names only members whose tags are historised, and every historised member of a device is in its list
The trend page's route exists whenever a device has a trended member

Each pipe's medium agrees with pipe_colour: a medium of wiki page 16 Table 13, buses neutral
The order of the original's regions and the sequence of each flow are kept; no region is split
The page canvas and its fill against the frame's canvas, as fit states
